scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1; finite transcript semantics only; no interactive verifier-view, oracle, probability, knowledge-error, or efficiency model.
statement: In the finite Bool/Unit transcript semantics defined by ZKSeparation, completeness and deterministic pointwise transcript equality coexist with failed perfect soundness and failed accepted-pair witness extraction; accepted-pair witness extraction implies perfect soundness. This is not GMR zero knowledge or Bellare--Goldreich proof of knowledge.
